'''Società Polisportiva La Fiorita''' is a [[San Marino|Sammarinese]] [[multi-sports club]], best known for its [[football (soccer)|football]] section, based in [[Montegiardino]]. The club was founded in [[1967 in association football|1967]]. Fiorita currently plays in ''Girone A'' of [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]]. The team's colours are blue, yellow and white."}}
